{"body":"**Current result.** On 4096×4096 frames the CUDA path adds a per-row constant to every globally shifted frame. The CPU path does not. A sub-pixel shift leaves the kx=0 and kx=nx/2 columns of the half spectrum non-Hermitian, so the spectrum no longer corresponds to a real image. FFTW's c2r drops the anti-Hermitian part. cuFFT 12.8's 2D C2R does the same at most sizes, but at 4096×4096 it turns that part into h(y) = −Im(IFFT_y of the column). The inputs and the transform contract are the same on both backends; the two libraries handle out-of-contract input differently. This is not float rounding.

**Evidence.**
- Standalone repro, no MotionCorr code: random real image → FFTW R2C → shift (0.3, 0.2) px → C2R with FFTW and with cuFFT. 4GPUs A100, CUDA 12.8.61.
  - 4096×4096: max |cuFFT − FFTW| = 8.2e-3 of max |image|; per-row constant rms 2.2e-3; spread within a row 1.2e-5.
  - Making the two columns Hermitian first, F(ky) ← (F(ky) + conj F(−ky))/2, reduces that to 4.0e-7.
  - 3710×3838 (both orientations), 4092×5760, 1024², 742×768 and every 1D length tested: no leak (≤1e-6).
- Measured inside MotionCorr in PR #250 (S1.3b, 10216 5×5 and 12963 5×5, both 4096²): the real frames after the global inverse FFT differ CPU vs CUDA by 7e-4–1e-2 relative, entirely as h(y). h(y) predicts the equal-trajectory patch-input difference to ≤5.8e-7.
- PR #243 places the 10216 5×5 relative-RMSE jump (0.018 → 0.434) at `58fd513a`, the commit that moved this inverse FFT onto cuFFT.
- Affected C2R calls on main: `cuda_movie_session.cu:2120` (global inverse), `cuda_realspace_dw.cu:388` (dose-weighted product sum), `cuda_fft_prep.cu:254`. Whether h(y) reaches the published micrographs is not yet measured.

**Not established.** Whether this term is the cause of the S1 local-alignment divergence (#238). S1-positive families include 5760×4092 (10641), and the 4096² families 10028 and Falcon 4 are S1-negative. So h(y) is at most one contributor.

**Next action.** A §9 CUDA fix: make kx=0 and kx=nx/2 Hermitian before each cuFFT C2R of a shifted spectrum, with a 4096² test that fails without the fix. Attribution runs in parallel under #238.

Both superpose (residual RMS **2.61e−7**); all four self-conjugate corner coefficients are exactly −1. This is consistent with a packed real inverse algorithm; cuFFT internals were not inspected.

On A100 / CUDA 12.8.61 / cuFFT **11.3.3**, the other six 2D geometries have fitted leak coefficients below **3.3e−8**; 1D 4096 gives exactly zero. Both plan APIs agree across all **112** cases. [Per-size table, source, coefficients, residuals and projected-input controls](https://github.com/KingAlejandro/MotionCorr-standalone/blob/af2a5900357e8e4dcdd83fb833ccb7e4fdaa5817/docs/post_rc0/issue253/review-20261021/README.md#injection-results).

Next action: retain explicit boundary projection in #254; treat Nyquist/cropping policy and downstream S1 validation separately.
